# smplkit_configuration (Data Source)

Read a smplkit configuration by id. Items and per-environment overrides are returned as JSON-encoded strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_configuration" "app_settings" {
  id = "app_settings"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The configuration key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `environments` (Map of Map of String) Per-environment item overrides, each JSON-encoded.
- `items` (Map of String) Base configuration values, each JSON-encoded.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `parent` (String) Parent configuration id.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
